business_name: Moe's Original BBQ Orange Beach, AL
description: Moe's Original BBQ is an authentic Alabama-style BBQ restaurant chain serving slow-smoked pulled pork, ribs, chicken, and house-made sauces across 40+ locations in the Southeast and beyond. Moe's Original BBQ Orange Beach is a top-rated barbecue restaurant in Orange Beach, Alabama, serving authentic Alabama-style BBQ, slow-smoked meats, and classic Southern sides with true Gulf Coast hospitality. Conveniently located near the heart of Orange Beach, this location is a favorite for locals and visitors looking for award-winning barbecue along Alabama's scenic Gulf Coast. Features a backyard dining oasis with full-service bar and stage, live music, and offers BBQ catering services for events.
